title: Split src/delegation_mcp.rs below 3,000 lines
outcome:
Found by the Claude /review-code of tm-5gi4 phase 2, round 9 (freeze 96039977), Low.

tm-5gi4 phase 2 adds the termal_name_source_root tool (tool_name_source_root plus source_root_tool_definition, about 57 lines) to src/delegation_mcp.rs, which takes the file from under 3,000 lines to 3,039. That is past the ~3,000-line threshold for Rust modules.

Fix direction: move the root-only tool definitions and bodies into a split module, or put the source-root tool beside engram_source_roots.rs. Per CLAUDE.md, a split commit is a pure code move, and each new file gets a header naming what it owns, what it does not own and the file it came from.
